The '''Arena of Games''' was a combat amphitheater that was established in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tekar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derilyn]] by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Afren Hul]], the world's [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] planetary [[Governor/Legends|governor]]. The stadium was a copy of the [[Rols'Kus]] arena on the planet [[Coyn]] and many [[Coynite/Legends|Coynites]] viewed the Arena of Games unfavorably, because they believed that it made a mockery of their combative system of honor. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agent [[Shondra Del]] was captured by the Empire and sentenced to [[Death/Legends|death]] in the Arena of Games, and she was forced to fight against some of Hul's Coynite [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiators]]. However. Del was subsequently rescued from the area by the [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] [[Mikos Argdran]] and a group of Rebel agents.
